			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = spice_plantation_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = spice_plantation_04 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = spice_plantation_04
			aub_can_upgrade_to_spice_plantation_05_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = spice_plantation_04
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = spice_plantation_05 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = spice_plantation_05
			aub_can_upgrade_to_spice_plantation_06_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = spice_plantation_05
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = spice_plantation_06 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = spice_plantation_06
			aub_can_upgrade_to_spice_plantation_07_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = spice_plantation_06
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = spice_plantation_07 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = spice_plantation_07
			aub_can_upgrade_to_spice_plantation_08_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = spice_plantation_07
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = spice_plantation_08 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
	}
}
